root_cause_located_in_source.mechanism: a 6-feature phrase touches 6*16=96 of 65536 slots. The other 8096 of 8192 rows are EMPTY and encode() fills EACH with a slot derived from the WHOLE-TEXT HASH. The fill is persisted and returned as the engram.

reading: Zeroing the hash-filled empty rows raises the FLAT LINEAR head 6x on held-out templates (0.0586 -> 0.3516, 45x chance) with clean controls. The codec's row_unit fill is a RETRIEVAL-side contract that damages the EGRESS path.

quantitative_prediction_check.fill_snr_scaling: signal slots 96 vs filler variance sqrt(8192): SNR ~ 96/sqrt(8192) ~ 1.06
quantitative_prediction_check.reading: same order; the mechanism predicts the effect size, it is not a fitting artifact

consequences.blueprint_diagnosis: REJECTED in its causal form. Blueprint sec 2.2/2.4 locates the bottleneck in the READOUT (linear projection head). The measured bottleneck is UPSTREAM, in the codec's own wave family. A linear head improves 6x once the codec fill is removed.
consequences.blueprint_readout_claim: NOT supported in this configuration. ARM-H (Hopfield) did worse than ARM-L (linear) in both variants; it collapsed to 0.0000 in ZERO.
consequences.residual_ceiling: 0.3516 is well short of 1.0. The fill is A cause, not the only cause. Cross-template variance of the 96-slot feature positions remains.
consequences.actionable_fix: Keep the fill for RETRIEVAL (row_unit gate). Strip it for EGRESS. Or make the fill content-independent (constant seed) so it adds no text-specific noise.

self_defects_caught: D3 [B,V,DC,2] materialization ~4.3 GiB in LinearHead.forward (OOM class of the [D,D] covariance blowup) -> matmul
D4 e[:, p] non-contiguous then .view(complex64) -> ascontiguousarray

D5 control used a global slot permutation (orthogonal; linear head learns W'=W P^T; destroys nothing) then a per-sample SLOT permutation (preserves active-block support, which IS the signal in ZERO; ctrl 0.1367 = 17x chance) -> per-sample BLOCK permutation, controls now at chance
